ci.canonical_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)); default ensure_ascii=True

android_report.limits: Synthetic login notification on an emulator; no physical phone or carrier delivery validated.

genuine_static_peer_checks.scope: ordinary-user static validation of staged public signed code

compatibility.limits: Genuine signed public code and a headless-only browser input in an ordinary-user temporary build. This is not the full-browser CI package variant, package installation, native approval, private accounts, phone delivery or dedicated-identity compatibility.

genuine_headless_runtime.scope: Ordinary-user temporary build; pinned headless shell and FFmpeg only. Counts include original and assembled runtime inputs, not only the smaller transport archive.

report.limits: Public signed transport before owner enrollment; no key, website login, personal account, phone, approval or consumer installation was validated.

connected_setup_changes: Owner-only Gmail OAuth PKCE with signed-app loopback callback and fixed Google scope/origins; publisher setup and live Google consent remain unverified.
One complete Google Authenticator export batch across up to 16 QR images, at most 100 entries; encrypted generation-bound atomic selected-entry enrollment.
Pinned official 1Password SDK service-account exact-item sync in an isolated bounded child; private enrollment, rotation and revocation remain unverified.
The native and web setup forms support the service-account source; Chrome CSV imports are snapshots.
A separate synthetic Chrome SMS account prevents interference from the real per-account 60-second retry cooldown; the fixed login deadline starts after public Chrome setup.

The authoritative owner app, executable and resources live under protected Library Application Support. Applications contains only the fixed literal navigation alias; programmatic launch, signature checks and runtime selection bind the canonical bundle.
Source-image and native Installer verification preserve the default shared Applications mode and require the exact alias without allowing other root aliases or traversing it as code authority.
The prepared-package native smoke checker maps exact distribution-version wheel platlib/purelib assets to their installed SDK paths and refuses unrelated wheel data destinations.
release_gates: Publisher Google OAuth client setup/verification and real mailbox consent, delivery and recovery.
Genuine owner enrollment/approval, private password-email-SMS-authenticator sign-ins and physical phone/carrier validation.
Private password-manager enrollment/rotation/revocation; Chrome continuous password synchronization is unimplemented.
Developer ID Installer certificate, Apple notarization/stapling, clean consumer installation and upgrade/migration/reboot recovery.
Complete genuine signed-worker website login, real isolated Claude Code/Codex sessions, broader reviewed providers and independent security review.
